links.outcome: Energy and protein accuracy of LLM-generated CKD meal plans versus prescribed targets
links.effect: All three LLMs failed to meet the 1800 kcal target, with values ranging from 1165 to 1548 kcal (P < 0.001); DeepSeek was closest to target energy and protein levels.
links.quote: All three LLMs failed to meet the 1800 kcal energy target, with values ranging from 1165 to 1548 kcal (P < 0.001).

links.outcome: Incorrect nutritional content in AI-generated dietary plans requiring verification before use
links.effect: All three LLMs failed the 1800 kcal target (1165-1548 kcal); authors conclude human oversight remains crucial for safety and efficacy of AI-generated dietary plans.
links.quote: As AI evolves, human oversight remains crucial in ensuring the safety and efficacy of AI-generated dietary plans.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the performance and nutritional accuracy of three LLMs (ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4.0, and DeepSeek) in generating dietary plans for chronic kidney disease using standardized prompts, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
